# Writing & editing

Helpers for grammar, clarity, rewriting, short-form copy, and long-form draft support. Good writing tools make your voice easier to read; they should not replace your judgment, your citations, or your final read-through.

**Last verified:** October 22, 2026 · **15 tools**

[Back to the guide](../README.md) · [All categories](README.md) · [Safety checklist](../free-tier-safety.md)

> **Category tip:** Keep an untouched copy of your draft before a big round of AI edits. Use suggestions as questions, not commands, and check every fact, quote, and citation yourself. Free accounts may process your text on a provider's server, so do not upload unpublished work you cannot afford to expose.

**Start here:** [Grammarly](#tool-grammarly) · [LanguageTool](#tool-languagetool) · [QuillBot](#tool-quillbot)

## All 15 tools

<a id="tool-grammarly"></a>

### Grammarly

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Free grammar, spelling, punctuation, tone, and clarity suggestions in the browser, desktop apps, and keyboard, plus a limited monthly allowance of generative AI prompts.
- **Sign-up notes:** Free Grammarly account; no card. Install the extension or app before using in-place suggestions.
- **Limits:** Advanced rewriting, plagiarism checks, citation tools, and full generative features are paid. Free AI prompt counts are capped. Text is processed in the cloud, so avoid confidential material.
- **Best for:** Everyday emails, applications, and professional writing where you want fast proofreading in place.
- **Official link:** <https://www.grammarly.com>
- **Tags:** `grammar` `tone` `browser` `beginner`

---

<a id="tool-quillbot"></a>

### QuillBot

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Paraphrasing with a limited word count per pass, grammar checking, citation helpers, and a free summarizer with caps.
- **Sign-up notes:** Free account with email or Google sign-in; no card. Word limits apply to each rewrite.
- **Limits:** Longer text, more rewriting modes, higher word counts, plagiarism checks, and faster processing are paid. Free output is not automatically plagiarism-safe or correct.
- **Best for:** Trying alternate sentence structures and checking grammar on short passages.
- **Official link:** <https://quillbot.com>
- **Tags:** `paraphrase` `grammar` `summarize` `students`

---

<a id="tool-languagetool"></a>

### LanguageTool

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Free browser extension and web editor for grammar, spelling, punctuation, and some style issues in many languages.
- **Sign-up notes:** Basic browser checks work without an account; sign-up is optional. Premium plans need payment, but the free checker does not.
- **Limits:** Free checks have text-length and feature caps. Advanced style, paraphrasing, and larger checks need Premium. The open-source LanguageTool core can also be self-hosted with technical work.
- **Best for:** Multilingual proofreading and quick grammar checks while writing in a browser.
- **Official link:** <https://languagetool.org>
- **Tags:** `grammar` `multilingual` `browser` `open-source-core`

---

<a id="tool-deepl-write"></a>

### DeepL Write

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** A free web editor that suggests clearer wording, tone improvements, and alternate phrasing in supported languages.
- **Sign-up notes:** No card for the free web access. Sign-in requirements and free limits vary; confirm on the current DeepL screen.
- **Limits:** Free access is limited compared with paid DeepL plans, and some features or higher usage are restricted. DeepL's data policies and language coverage matter before uploading sensitive text.
- **Best for:** Polishing English or translated text when you want fewer awkward phrases and a more natural tone.
- **Official link:** <https://www.deepl.com/write>
- **Tags:** `clarity` `editing` `translation` `non-native`

<a id="tool-sapling"></a>

### Sapling

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Free grammar, spelling, and completion assistance for individuals, including an editing web app and integrations.

- **Limits:** Team features, advanced AI generation, analytics, and higher usage are paid. The free allowance and supported integrations can change.

<a id="tool-wordtune"></a>

### Wordtune

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Daily free rewrite suggestions, short-form AI writing help, and a browser extension for improving sentences.
- **Sign-up notes:** Free account with email or Google sign-in; no card. Daily rewrite allowances apply.
- **Limits:** Free daily rewrites and document actions are capped; advanced tone, longer text, and unlimited use are paid. Review its cloud data terms.

<a id="tool-rytr"></a>

### Rytr

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** A free monthly character allowance for short AI writing jobs, with a menu of templates and tone options.
- **Sign-up notes:** Free account with email or Google sign-in; no card. Monthly character limits apply.
- **Limits:** Monthly characters are limited, and some use cases, tones, languages, and higher-quality modes are paid. Output needs factual and brand review.
- **Best for:** First-draft product blurbs, social captions, and other short copy on a tight budget.
- **Official link:** <https://rytr.me>

<a id="tool-simplified"></a>

### Simplified

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Free access to an all-in-one writing, design, and short-video workspace with a limited allowance of AI credits and projects.

<a id="tool-tinywow"></a>

### TinyWow

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Free browser tools for AI writing, summarizing, PDF conversion, image cleanup, and other small jobs without installing software.
- **Sign-up notes:** No account required for many tools; no card. Ads, queues, and daily limits apply.
- **Limits:** Usage is metered by daily limits and fair-use rules; ads and queues are part of the deal. Uploaded files may be processed or retained under its policy, so avoid sensitive documents.
- **Best for:** One-off conversions and short writing chores when installing another app is not worth it.
- **Official link:** <https://tinywow.com>
- **Tags:** `utilities` `no-install` `pdf` `quick-tasks`

### HyperWrite

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Free AI writing assistance with a monthly allowance of generations, rewriting, and suggestions in the web app and browser extension.

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

<a id="tool-koboldcpp"></a>

### KoboldCpp

`Open source` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** A free, open-source local text-generation app for creative writing, role-play, and experimentation with downloaded models.
- **Sign-up notes:** Download the official release; no account or card. You supply the local model files.
- **Limits:** You need a capable computer, patience with model downloads, and willingness to configure settings. Model quality, licensing, and content policies vary by model.
- **Best for:** Fiction, brainstorming, and private local experimentation on hardware you control.
- **Official link:** <https://github.com/LostRuins/koboldcpp>
- **Tags:** `local` `fiction` `privacy` `offline`

<a id="tool-text-generation-webui"></a>

### Text Generation WebUI

`Open source` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Open-source, local notebook-style interface for running many language models with adjustable prompting and writing tools.
- **Sign-up notes:** Install from the official repository; no account or card. The setup is technical.
- **Limits:** Installing models and dependencies is technical. GPU memory determines usable model size. No hosted service is included, and outputs still need human editing.
- **Best for:** Writers and tinkerers who want direct control over local models and prompting.
- **Official link:** <https://github.com/oobabooga/text-generation-webui>
- **Tags:** `local` `advanced` `fiction` `models`

<a id="tool-microsoft-editor"></a>

### Microsoft Editor

`Free tier` · Last verified: 2026-10-22

- **What is free:** Free basic spelling, grammar, and style suggestions in Edge and Microsoft's web writing surfaces with a Microsoft account.
- **Sign-up notes:** Microsoft account for full free features; no card. Basic browser checking may be available in Edge without a paid plan.
- **Limits:** Advanced rewriting, full-document analysis, and some AI features are tied to Microsoft 365. Free suggestions are limited and not a substitute for a final edit.
- **Best for:** A no-cost proofreading layer if Microsoft Edge or Word on the web is already part of your day.
- **Official link:** <https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/microsoft-editor>
- **Tags:** `grammar` `microsoft` `browser` `proofreading`
